decisions.evidence: R1 maker P1 'paste an address, it's stored'; conforms to save-by-url.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Presented save-by-url conforms to reference; no divergence.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker P3 'delete with a confirmation step'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Delete present and conforming.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker P2 'click to open the original page in a new tab'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Open-original conforms.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker P3 'edit title/notes/tags', tags supported.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Tag assignment present.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker P3 'tag-based filtering'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Tag filtering conforms.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker Q2 default 'Manual entry only' deferring import; R1 client 'I do need import from a standard browser-bookmarks HTML file, preserving titles, tags, and dates.'
decisions.note: Spec gate, offered choice. Default (manual-only) diverges from REF-BM-30; client selected the reference-conforming import alternative.

decisions.evidence: R1 client 'I'd also like export in that same format.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Export was neither offered nor in the R1 spec; client requested this missing reference requirement.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker spec had only 'stored with a title and add-date; missing titles are derived' (no auto-collection); R1 client 'Saving should automatically collect the page title, description, favicon, and preview image, while letting me edit the title and description before or after saving.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. R1 omits auto-metadata; client supplies the reference-conforming behaviour.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker P3 'duplicate-address warning'; R1 client 'Saving an address that already exists should take me to the existing bookmark to edit it, not merely warn me.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. R1 'warning' contradicts REF-BM-06 (guide to edit existing); client supplies conforming behaviour.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker P3 'edit title/notes/tags'; R1 client 'I should be able to edit the address itself as well as the title, description, note, and tags.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. R1 edit scope omits url and description; client corrects to full REF-BM-04 scope.

decisions.evidence: R1 client 'Existing tags should be suggested as I type.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Tag autocomplete absent from R1 spec; client requests the missing reference requirement.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker P2 'keyword search across title/address/tags'; R1 client 'Search should include titles, descriptions, notes, and addresses, be case-insensitive, support #tag, exact quoted phrases, and AND/OR/NOT with parentheses.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. R1 search omits description/note, case-insensitivity, #tag, phrases, and boolean operators; client supplies the reference-conforming search behaviour.

decisions.evidence: R1 client 'I need unread/read-later and archived views ... mark read/unread'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Read-later/unread views absent from R1; client requests these missing reference requirements.

decisions.evidence: R1 client 'Archiving must be reversible and separate from permanent deletion; archived items should stay out of the normal list and search.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Archive feature absent from R1; client requests reversible archive distinct from delete plus separate view.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker P2 'newest-first list'; R1 client 'I need sorting beyond newest-first, plus selecting several bookmarks—or everything matching the current view—to tag, mark read/unread, archive, or delete together.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. R1 had only fixed newest-first and no bulk actions; client requests sort keys and multi-select/select-all-matching bulk actions.

decisions.evidence: R1 client 'Notes should support formatted Markdown when viewed.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Markdown rendering absent from R1; client requests the missing reference requirement.

decisions.evidence: R1 client 'Please include saved filters combining a search with included or excluded tags.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Bundles/saved filters absent from R1; client requests the missing reference requirement.

decisions.evidence: R1 client 'Each saved page should have a local snapshot, with PDFs stored as PDFs, plus an option to preserve it through the Internet Archive.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Snapshots (local + Internet Archive) absent from R1; client requests the missing reference requirements.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker P2 list shows title/address/tags; R1 client 'The list should show the description and favicon as well as the title and tags.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. R1 list omits description and favicon; client supplies the reference-conforming list fields.

decisions.evidence: R1 client 'basic display preferences such as default sorting, number of items shown, and font size.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Display preferences absent from R1; client requests the missing reference requirement.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker search row states 'AND/OR/NOT with parentheses' but not the combine/quoting rules; R2 client 'When ordinary search text and a #tag appear together, both must match. Also, AND, OR, and NOT should act as operators unless quoted, in which case they are searched as ordinary words.'
decisions.note: Spec gate (refinement). The R2 presentation omitted REF-BM-15's quoting rule and the tag+text AND-combine edge rule; client makes them explicit. Same requirement as R1 search but finer detail at a later point.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker 'Local snapshot per page, PDFs stored as PDFs'; R2 client 'A local web-page snapshot should be stored as a self-contained single HTML file. PDF links should continue to be downloaded and stored as PDFs.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. R2 did not specify the single-file HTML form of REF-BM-24; client makes the reference detail explicit.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker clarification 'interpreted standard browser-bookmarks HTML file as the classic Netscape bookmark format'; R2 client 'Everything else, including the Netscape browser-bookmarks format assumption, matches what I want.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Maker raised a non-blocking assumption; the Netscape format conforms to REF-BM-30/31, and client confirmed it. Conforming clarification resolved same round, not a divergence.

decisions.evidence: R4 maker plan 'Save is fast, enrichment is async ... metadata (title/description/favicon/preview) ... run in a background queue'; R4 client 'it says the bookmark is created immediately and its title and description appear later in the background. I approved seeing the automatically collected details for review—and being able to change them—before I commit ... if the page cannot be read promptly, I should be able to continue with the fallback details ... background work can never overwrite a title or description I have entered or edited.'
decisions.note: Plan gate. The plan's async-metadata flow contradicts REF-BM-03 (edit auto-collected details before saving), a divergence newly introduced at plan stage; client supplies the reference-conforming review-before-commit behaviour with fallback and edit-protection. Same requirement re-surfaced at a later stage.

decisions.evidence: R6 maker tasks describe preview/commit persisting reviewed title/description; R6 client 'The final save must store the favicon and preview image returned by the review step, along with the reviewed title and description. Please include this in both the save task and its test.' R7 maker confirms 'T019 now persists the faviconPath and previewImagePath ... T016 now asserts ... favicon, and preview image' (corroborating prior omission).
decisions.note: Tasks gate. Presented save tasks omitted persisting favicon/preview image (required by REF-BM-02 and shown per REF-BM-07); client requests the missing persistence, corroborated by the maker's R7 addition.

decisions.evidence: R6 maker offered 'narrow the initial scope (e.g. build the MVP US1 first, then stop)'; R6 client 'I want the full application built, not a stop after the one-story MVP.'
decisions.note: Tasks gate, offered choice. The offered MVP-only alternative would drop nearly all reference features beyond save (US2–US10); client selected the reference-conforming full build. Listed ref_items are representative of the post-US1 feature set.

decision.evidence: R1 maker Q1 default 'Single-user, no login'; R1 client 'keep it single-user with no login'.
decision.note: Spec gate. Multi-user is infra (REF-BM-I01), excluded from denominator; single-user conforms to the reference overview. Orthogonal choice, not a reference functional divergence.
